description: This Java class 'ResourceDataValidator' extends 'DataValidator' to perform validation logic for 'TbResource' objects, including checks for resource data, size, tenant existence, and resource properties.

classes.name: ResourceDataValidator
classes.description: A Spring component class that validates 'TbResource' objects for creation, update, and data integrity, including size constraints and tenant validation.

methods.name: validateCreate
methods.description: Validates that the resource data is not null or empty during creation.

methods.name: validateUpdate
methods.description: Checks if the resource type can be updated; disallows updates for certain resource types.

methods.name: validateDataImpl
methods.description: Performs comprehensive validation of resource properties, including title, tenant, type, data size, filename, and resource key.

methods.name: validateResourceSize
methods.description: Validates that the resource size does not exceed tenant-specific maximums and updates size constraints accordingly.
